integrity.proof_scope: All pairs of nonempty finite simple graphs, including isolates, disconnected graphs and one-vertex factors.
integrity.verification: Finite direct enumeration confirms the bivariate identity on 281 graph pairs; no independent audit performed.

scientific_limitations: The identity is for pointwise-minimal standard Roman dominating functions of complete joins of two nonempty finite simple graphs. Its right-hand side requires the factor enumerators. Exact calculations cover finitely many small graph pairs; the proof is combinatorial. Publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact minimal-Roman census of graph joins
